sources.title: Mspanz88/playground-lm-onnx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The exporter names the q8 output model.int8.onnx internally; publication names explicitly use .q8.onnx. Both models completed CPU ONNX execution through context 1024, varied text/random lengths, batch size 2, full-vocabulary finite-logit checks, and six independent 16-token greedy generation comparisons.
